newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: MCL, Pidemco to develop industrial sites.
newsitem.headline: MCL, Pidemco to develop industrial sites.

text.p: MCL Land Ltd and government linked Pidemco Land Ltd said on on Thursday they had set up a joint venture to develop a Singapore $800 million industrial park in the eastern part of Singapore.
They said in a joint statement the park would be built on two sites totaling 120,000 sq m which the two companies had secured from a government land sale in February 1997.
Plans for the sites include terrace and high-tech factory blocks targetted at clean and light industries.
The park will be built in phases with construction of the terrace and flatted factories beginning by mid 1998. The whole project should be completed by 2,005, the statement said.
